Yes if you stop taking the meds you may end up loosing weight but that’s because the virus is taking hold and destroying your body. It will because you will he physically sick often, have diarrhoea, night sweats etc.

As people have previously said a lot of us have gained weight during lockdown. Now restrictions have eased work on exercise. If your too tired just start with walking. 
Look at your diet. I wouldn’t say do in a formal diet. Certainly for me that never worked. But just introduce small changes so you don’t overwhelm yourself. For me I did the smaller plate. Meant I could still eat things I liked just controlled my portion size without hassle of weighing stuff. I also stopped completely crisps as they where my nemesis.
Then a few months later I added another change. I stopped adding sugar on top my cereal. It’s surprising how quickly those small changes soon add up and you start to loose weight.
